title: Demu
tagline: Demu is a decentralized audio platform. It allows for secure sharing, listening and monetization of music, cutting out intermediaries and empowering artists and listeners.
description: Demu is a next-generation decentralized audio streaming platform that utilizes blockchain technology to revolutionize the way music is shared, consumed, and monetized. With Demu, listeners have access to a vast library of music from a global community of artists, all without the need for intermediaries. The platform operates on a decentralized network, enabling artists to upload their music directly to the platform, and fans to discover and support their favorite artists without any third-party involvement. Demu leverages smart contracts to provide a secure, transparent, and fair ecosystem, where all transactions are recorded on a public ledger. This ensures that artists receive fair compensation for their work and listeners have access to a vast library of music at an affordable price. Demu aims to disrupt the traditional music industry by cutting out the middlemen, reducing costs, and giving more control to the artists and their fans.
how_its_made: Demu is built on a combination of cutting-edge technologies that provide a seamless user experience and ensure the platform operates smoothly. The platform is powered by Prisma, a modern GraphQL ORM that provides a flexible and efficient way of storing and retrieving data. The platform is built using Next.js, a popular React-based framework that enables fast and efficient server-side rendering and dynamic page updates. The audio files are stored on IPFS (InterPlanetary File System), a decentralized, peer-to-peer file sharing network that ensures high availability and fast access to audio files. The platform's user interface is designed using TailwindCSS, a highly customizable CSS framework that provides a clean and modern look. Demu also leverages NFT (Non-Fungible Tokens) technology to create unique, one-of-a-kind tokens that represent the ownership and authenticity of audio files, making the platform a true decentralized audio streaming ecosystem.
